Sintel: Young woman warrior and protagonist searching for her companion dragon Scales; has short dark-brown hair (later shoulder-length and weathered in Act IV), wears a brown tunic and travel cloak, and wields a wooden staff in Act I before claiming the Gatekeeper's curved spear-blade.
Scales: Small, playful baby red dragon with large amber eyes and an injured wing bandaged and nursed back to health by Sintel.
Adult Dragon: Massive, fierce winged red dragon with large leathery wings (bearing a healed notch scar on one wing); snatches Scales from the sky over Ishtar and later lairs in a dark volcanic cavern alongside a fledgling baby dragon.
Shaman: Elderly tribal healer and gatekeeper with long white dreadlocks and ceremonial robes who questions Sintel inside a warmly lit desert hut.
Gatekeeper: Masked warrior wearing a full ceremonial mask and heavy robes who guards the snowy mountain pass and wields a distinctive curved spear-blade with a circular hilt ring.
